target.statement: Best family-level mean subject-level accuracy on Cho2017: cov-tgsp in 8-30 Hz = 0.712 ± 0.140

compute.basis: The headline number is a family-level mean over 52 subjects of a full grid of pipelines (feature family x 2 bands x ~9 preprocessors x ~22 classifiers incl. 17 MLPs), i.e. tens of thousands of MOABB within-session fits on 64-channel 512 Hz data; even one family/band cell requires running the whole pipeline grid for all 52 subjects, which is hours of CPU work and depends on the repo's exact grid being runnable.

blockers: Target is an aggregate over a very large pipeline grid (216k raw evaluations), not a single cheap run
Repo may not contain the exact grid/configs or the aggregated results needed to reproduce the exact mean
Cho2017 download is large (~several GB) and MOABB preprocessing is slow on CPU
title: Subject-Level Heterogeneity in EEG Motor Imagery Decoding: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Portfolio-Based Reduction of the Search Space
